name: CONSTRUCT SERVANTS
originalText:
#### CONSTRUCT SERVANTS

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Forgeborn & Magicmade
- **Source Page:** 11

```text
Target A pile of spare parts worth 2 gc resting on a flat
surface you can reach
Duration 8 hours
You concentrate for 1 minute, during which time you
assemble one or more servants from the target parts. At the
end of this time, the target either becomes 2 small constructs
or 1 medium construct that remain for the duration or until
destroyed. The construct(s) act on your turn, following your
spoken instructions to the letter. When the effect ends, the
construct(s) collapse piles of spare parts.
```
